blocks.text: Here is the coverage for the first week back, before it goes on the board. The office is thin through Wednesday, so I want the desk staffed the whole time and nothing left sitting on someone who is out.

items: Docket desk: Sharon Woods, Monday and Tuesday.
Phones and mail: Amanda Schwartz, all week.

blocks.text: On the admin: get anything with a near deadline onto the calendar early, and tell the front desk by Thursday if supplies need ordering before quarter-end. Flag any gap to me by Wednesday.
